reviews.reason: The submitted CIFs are valid, fully occupied TlCNO realizations with the stated cell; the primary reduces to an 8-atom primitive Ima2 structure, has sensible O-C-N distances and periodic contacts, and its indexed positions and integrated intensities are strongly supported. However, all three submissions vary only the orientation ordering of the same O-C-N assignment. The trace never tests which light atom occupies the central 4d site. A concrete N-centered C-N-O realization can be instantiated in the same indexed cell with full TlCNO stoichiometry, no short-contact failure, and refined N-C/N-O distances of 1.238/1.247 angstrom. Against the blind pattern it remains comparably viable: its integrated-intensity R1 is 2.44% versus 1.63% for O-C-N, and an identically parameterized fixed-coordinate whole-profile fit gives 0.11315 versus 0.11275. This material element-ordering branch is absent from the submitted set and is not quantitatively rejected strongly enough to establish exact recovery.

The primary CIF is valid and strongly supported: it round-trips as fully occupied Tl4C4N4O4 in the stated 6.338353 x 6.338353 x 7.402687 angstrom cell, reduces to an 8-atom primitive Ima2 structure, covers the important indexed reflections, gives an instantiated-CIF integrated-intensity R1 of about 1.52%, and has linear O-C-N units (1.181/1.168 angstrom) with no short-contact or coordination-shell failure. However, the set does not fully cover the concrete N-centered ordering ambiguity that alternative-3 retains. That file is only the Ima2 C/O orientation order. Fully occupied, primitive-inequivalent Ama2 and Pbcm C-N-O orientation orders instantiate in the same refined cell with the same linear 1.238/1.247 angstrom bonds and no overlap; their comparable exact-model integrated-intensity R1 values are about 2.376% and 2.380%, essentially the same as alternative-3 at 2.372%. Their strongest ordering reflections are below 0.06% of the main peak and below the profile noise, so the blind pattern does not reject them. These material element-ordering/symmetry realizations are absent and are specific viable branches another attempt can add.

reviews.proposed_branch: Instantiate and directly full-profile-refine representatives of the missing full-occupancy O/N-ordering classes in the indexed orthorhombic cell: Pm 0001 and the second Ima2 0101 class.
reviews.reason: Both submitted CIFs are valid explicit Tl4C4N4O4, Z=4, full-occupancy P1 expansions: the primary standardizes to Ima2 with primitive Z=2 and the alternative to distinct Pbcm with primitive Z=4. They have no overlaps, linear O-C-N units (1.203 A), plausible complete Tl-terminal shells, strong indexed line coverage, and good instantiated integrated-intensity agreement. However, exact O/N orientation ordering is not covered. The trace's own 16-ordering comparison leaves an unsubmitted Pm one-flip class at score 0.3220 versus 0.3214 for the primary and 0.3225 for the submitted Pbcm model, and an unsubmitted, structure-distinct second Ima2 class (0101) ties the primary at 0.3214. Independent standardization confirms these are not mere settings or supercells; they retain the same valid stoichiometry and local chemistry. Their largest calculated intensity differences are about 0.016 on a 100-point scale, below the observed off-peak noise sigma of about 0.113, so the trace does not reject them. Another attempt can therefore add materially different viable ordered realizations.
